text:
elena: kicking off a config-only deploy in the 01:10-01:40 PT change window. small, staged: max_concurrency 48 -> 34, timeout 60s -> 44s, batch_window 12ms -> 6ms, slight routing weight nudge. canary plan: 1% -> 12% -> 100%. notes: https://go/release/2026-03-tinybatch-surgeplan
marco: copy. attach preflight and add abort gates: p95 +22% OR 5xx_rate >0.5% for 120s. pin fallback route policy `route:stable-v1` before canary.
release-bot: preflight checklist posted: warm_kv, pin-fallback, prepare soft-throttle, alert channels set.
oncall: monitoring set for p95_latency, 5xx_rate, kv_cache_miss, gpu_mem_pressure. alert if 5xx_rate >0.5% for 2m or p95 > baseline*1.22.
elena: deploying config snippet:
```json
{
  "max_concurrency": 34,
  "timeout_s": 44,
  "batch_window_ms": 6,
  "routing_weights": {"canary-tiny": 1, "default": 99}
}
```
deploybot: deploybot: release "tinybatch-surgeplan-2026-03" queued by elena. pipeline: validate -> canary(1%) -> wait(10m) -> canary(12%) -> wait(15m) -> ramp(100%). running preflight smoke.
deploybot: preflight smoke: OK (auth, quick-gen, healthcheck)
elena: running warm_kv for high QPS tenants before canary.
deploybot: canary(1%) started at 01:13:10 PT. distributing across 3 AZs. monitoring.
marco: early check: p50 slightly better, p95 stable, kv_cache_miss +14% (expected).
oncall: watch tenant M (high qps). if tenant M 5xx >1% isolate with `tenant-exclude M`.
deploybot: canary(1%) passed 10m gate. proceeding to 12% at 01:25:30 PT.
elena: re-warmed caches.
marco: at 12% we see a transient 5xx burst from tenant R (tenant_5xx ~2.8%). applying tenant-exclude R and routing them to fallback.
oncall: tenant-exclude R applied; fallback route route:stable-v1 for R enabled. overall 5xx back under threshold.
marco: ops note: if p95 climbs and GPU mem >85% prefer soft-throttle: batch_window_ms -> 4 and max_concurrency -> 28 before rollback. add to runbook.
elena: added soft-throttle steps to runbook.
deploybot: ramp to 100% started at 01:36:40 PT. final healthchecks OK.
marco: post-ramp: p95 down ~9% vs baseline, cost per request down slightly, no sustained 5xx.
elena: closing change window early at 01:38. tagging config commit cfg@e7d9a1. will file post-deploy summary tomorrow AM.
release-bot: release marked success. performance snapshot saved to perf-archive/tinybatch-surgeplan/2026-03.
oncall: thanks team, closing thread.
